description:
Lydon Farrell Property are delighted to present this prestigious family home for sale in the well renowned and popular residential development known as Athlumney Close. This excellent three / four bedroom semi detached house is presented in fantastic condition with the current owners upgrading and maintaining the property to a very high standard. Some of the enhancements include a high specification attic conversion and a professionally landscaped rear garden. 

The current owners have tastefully decorated the property ensuring the house has retained its fresh modern interior throughout and is in walk in condition for a new owner. The ground floor accommodation comprises of an entrance hall, a bright large living room to the front, guest WC, storage closet and an open plan kitchen / dining room to the rear. On the first floor there are three spacious bedrooms including a master ensuite and a family bathroom. The property contains an attic conversion which includes a home office and a separate space that is currently used as a bedroom but holds the capacity for a variety of different uses. The home benefits from parking to the front along with a low maintenance rear garden with artificial grass and paved granite area. 

29 Athlumney Close is within walking distance of a host of local amenities including both primary and secondary schools. . The property is excellently located within walking distance to Supervalu Johnstown and both Primary & Secondary Schools are just a short stroll away. Transport links to Dublin are convenient with junction 8 of the M3 Motorway just 2.5km, 25 minute drive times to the M50 and the Nx Bus just a short walk with a 24-hour service to Dublin city centre. 

Viewings by appointment.
